fullstack.title: Full Stack Web Development
fullstack.description: I build web applications and Telegram bots for 100+ companies. With 5+ years on the market, I know how to solve any business challenge. I implement frontend and backend with React/Vue + FastAPI/Django and work professionally with PostgreSQL/MySQL and Redis/MongoDB.

devops.title: DevOps & Automation
devops.description: I've built automation for 50+ businesses worldwide — my solutions have saved clients $60k+. I'm proficient in CI/CD and Docker and take every project through to deployment on a VPS or dedicated server. My stack: Playwright/Selenium, userbots for account automation, and reliable bypass of Captcha and Cloudflare protection.

genai.title: AI Integration
genai.description: I've integrated AI into projects for roles like data analysts, business assistants, and support managers. I professionally build RAG architectures: connecting LLMs to company CRMs and knowledge bases for accurate, hallucination-free answers. My stack: OpenAI/Claude API, LangChain/LlamaIndex, vector DBs (ChromaDB/Pinecone/Qdrant), and backend integration.
